description: Three pairs of signals multiplied together, in 2HP, chained so that one input can feed all three

inputs.text: The first signal of that section; with the jack empty it reads the output of the section above, and 0V in the first section
The second signal of that section; with the jack empty it reads the B input of the section above, and the A input of its own section in the first

outputs.text: Carries that section's two signals multiplied together, after each has been scaled and had its negatives handled as the menu says

notes: patching A1 alone gives the signal squared at the first output, then squared again at each section below, because of the chaining
each B input is divided by 10 before the multiply unless changed, so a 0V to 10V signal there is a gain of 0x to 1x
the light above each jack shows its scaling: green divide by 10, yellow divide by 5, dark none; the light below is blue where negatives are made positive, red where cut to 0V
menu: A1 input, A2 input, A3 input, B1 input, B2 input, B3 input — each holds a Scale-mode and a Negative-mode for that one jack
Set all A inputs, Set all B inputs — applies one Scale-mode or one Negative-mode to all three A jacks or all three B jacks at once
Quantize mode — rounds the output to the nearest step of the size chosen, from a twelfth of a volt up to 5V, and is Off unless you set it
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed

unpatched it reads the output of the section above.
